_comment: Optimization mods the build script resolves from Modrinth for Minecraft 1.21.11 / Fabric.
'slug' is a hint only: if it 404s the script falls back to a Modrinth search on 'name',
so a renamed project self-heals instead of breaking the build.
'enabled': false ships the jar as <name>.jar.disabled - present but not loaded.
Edit this file and re-run the build script to change the pack.

Every mod below was checked against Modrinth for a 1.21.11 Fabric build on the date in 'verified_on'; the version confirmed is in each entry's 'verified' field. The build script still resolves the newest build at run time, so it may install something newer.

mods.name: Lithium
mods.reason: Rewrites game logic: mob AI, collisions, pathfinding and explosion raycasts. The single biggest win for crystal PvP, because popping a crystal is explosion math and Lithium makes it dramatically cheaper.

mods.name: FerriteCore
mods.reason: Cuts blockstate and model memory by roughly 30-50%. Important on 16GB, where you can only spare ~6GB of heap.

mods.name: ModernFix-mVUS
mods.reason: Large bundle of memory, startup and render fixes; dynamic resource loading cuts RAM further. Upstream ModernFix stops at 1.21.1; mVUS is the maintained fork that carries it to 1.21.11.

mods.name: Entity Culling
mods.reason: Async raycasting on spare 3700X cores to skip rendering and ticking entities you cannot actually see.

mods.name: More Culling
mods.reason: Extends culling to block entities, item frames and leaves that Sodium alone still draws.

mods.name: BadOptimizations
mods.reason: Dozens of small, safe render and tick optimizations vanilla leaves on the table.

mods.name: ThreadTweak
mods.reason: Tunes worker thread counts and priorities. Your 8c/16t 3700X has cores to spare; this stops them fighting the render thread.

mods.name: Dynamic FPS
mods.reason: Throttles the game when alt-tabbed, so background CPU/GPU goes back to the foreground.

mods.name: Cull Fewer Leaves
mods.reason: Culls interior leaf faces. Large win in any forest. Cull Less Leaves stopped at 1.21.1; Cull Fewer Leaves is its continuation.

mods.name: Better Block Entities
mods.reason: Renders chests, signs and beds as fast static models instead of per-frame block entities. Enhanced Block Entities stopped at 1.21.4; Better Block Entities is the active equivalent. Its 1.21.11 builds are release candidates, so this is the least battle-tested mod in the pack - disable it first if chests or signs render oddly.

mods.name: ScalableLux
mods.reason: Multithreaded lighting engine. Smoother chunk loading, fewer light-update hitches.

mods.name: C2ME
mods.reason: Parallel chunk loading and generation. Singleplayer only - no effect when you are on someone else's server.

mods.name: NoisiumForked
mods.reason: Faster worldgen. Singleplayer only. Upstream Noisium has no 1.21.11 build; NoisiumForked does.

mods.name: Alternate Current
mods.reason: Much cheaper redstone implementation. Singleplayer only.

mods.name: Language Reload
mods.reason: Faster startup and less RAM held by language data.

mods.name: spark
mods.reason: Profiler. Ships disabled. Enable it and run /spark profiler when you want to know what is actually costing you frames instead of guessing.

mods.name: Nvidium
mods.reason: NVIDIA-only terrain renderer that can be a very large win on an RTX 2060 Super. Ships DISABLED because it is reported broken against Sodium 0.8.x on 1.21.11. Try it last, and disable it again if you crash or see missing chunks.

mods.name: Exordium
mods.reason: Draws the HUD at a lower framerate than the world. Free FPS, but it adds visible HUD latency, which is bad for PvP. Ships disabled; enable only if you are still short on frames.
